body.blazor:
<HarborlineDataExportButton Label="Export data" Formats="AllFormats" OnExport="HandleExport"/>
@code { private static readonly IReadOnlyList<ExportFormat> AllFormats=[ExportFormat.Csv,ExportFormat.Xlsx,ExportFormat.Pdf,ExportFormat.Json,ExportFormat.Md]; private static Task HandleExport(ExportFormat format)=>Task.CompletedTask; }
body.rationale: The closed descriptor vocabulary has no export menu-button, format-menu, or menu-item control, so it cannot express the five-format DataExportButton without losing its structure and behavior.

bodyAppend.rationale: The closed descriptor vocabulary cannot represent two additional DataExportButton component instances while preserving their distinct disabled and loading props and export-menu behavior.
